visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair stands in a minimalist white-walled room with a brown sofa and a modern black floor lamp. She is wearing a green sleeveless mock-neck top and light-wash blue jeans while holding a large, bulky cardboard box. (2) She opens the box with an enthusiastic smile, revealing its contents. A still photograph is briefly shown depicting a group of four people, including two children, standing in a snowy field wearing heavy winter attire. (3) Back in the studio, she models a brown form-fitting tank top. She uses both hands to pull and stretch the fabric significantly to demonstrate its high elasticity and ribbed texture. (4) She holds up a similar beige tank top while pointing to a brand graphic overlay. She gestures towards her chest area to highlight the fit and internal support of the garment. (5) A short mirror-selfie video segment shows her in a wooden-paneled room wearing black thermal base layers tucked into white and black ski pants. (6) She returns to the main studio setting to model wide-leg denim jeans. She points to the unique button-loop adjustment system at the waist and shows off the oversized pockets and 3D seams. (7) She changes into a black sheer mesh long-sleeve top worn over a black tank top, paired with a long leopard-print skirt. She rotates her body to show the drape and fabric of the skirt. (8) She presents a bright lime-yellow puffer jacket, holding it up to show its bulk and soft texture. She demonstrates a magnetic closure by bringing the flaps together, where they snap shut instantly without manual buttoning. (9) She puts on the yellow puffer jacket and poses with high-energy facial expressions, looking surprised at the warmth and magnetic feature. (10) She concludes by standing with her arms wide, showcasing the full ensemble of the yellow jacket, white tank top, and wide-leg jeans in the bright studio lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-tempo pop BGM with a strong electronic beat begins. An energetic female voice with high arousal and a bright pitch starts speaking rapidly, introducing a clothing haul. (2) Faint clothing rustling is audible as she moves items. A cheerful 'ding' SFX sounds as the first text graphic appears. (3) The vocal narration remains continuous and high-energy, describing technical garment details like elasticity. Short 'pop' SFX accompany frequent text updates. (4) The BGM maintains a consistent 125 BPM pace. A clear, sharp metallic 'click' sound is heard twice when she demonstrates the jacket's magnetic closure. (5) The speaker's volume increases slightly during expressions of excitement about the jacket's fit. The mix is studio-clean with a high signal-to-noise ratio and bright spectral brightness. (6) Final enthusiastic summary by the female speaker before the BGM and vocals cut out abruptly at the end.
